grain_rationale: row_count is 13014 and duplicate_row_rate is 0.0, so the source carries no exact duplicate rows; airport_code has only 3 distinct values and observed_hour_utc has 4341 distinct values, neither unique alone, but the pair (airport_code, observed_hour_utc) identifies one hourly observation per airport, matching the near-product of 3*4341=13023 against the observed row_count of 13014, so a derived identity over that pair gives one row per transaction with no duplicates to absorb.

fields.name: airport_code
fields.description: Three-letter airport code (EWR, JFK, LGA per distinct_values) identifying the observing station, never null across 13014 rows.

fields.name: observed_hour_utc
fields.description: UTC timestamp at hourly resolution (samples show :00:00 minutes/seconds, range 2013-01-01T06:00:00 to 2013-07-01T03:00:00) timestamping each weather observation event.

fields.name: observed_date_local
fields.description: Local calendar date of the observation (range 2013-01-01 to 2013-06-30, 181 distinct values), never null.

fields.name: observed_hour_local
fields.description: Local hour of day label (0-23, 24 distinct values), a descriptive time label rather than a measured quantity, never null.

fields.name: temp_f
fields.description: Air temperature in Fahrenheit (min 10.94, max 93.92 across 130 distinct values), a measured quantity compared and averaged across rows, never null.

fields.name: dewpoint_f
fields.description: Dewpoint temperature in Fahrenheit (min -9.94, max 73.94 across 119 distinct values), a measured quantity, never null.

fields.name: humidity_pct
fields.description: Relative humidity percentage (min 12.74, max 100.0 across 2178 distinct values), a measured quantity, never null.

fields.name: wind_dir_degrees
fields.description: Wind direction in compass degrees 0-360 (37 distinct values), a directional label rather than a summable measure; nullable in 1.68% of rows (null_rate 0.016828), likely when wind is calm.

fields.name: wind_speed_mph
fields.description: Wind speed in mph (min 0.0, max 1048.36 across 36 distinct values), a measured quantity; nullable in a small fraction of rows (null_rate 0.000154).

fields.name: wind_gust_mph
fields.description: Wind gust speed in mph (range 16.11 to 62.14 across 35 distinct values), a measured quantity; nullable in most rows (null_rate 0.745505), consistent with gusts only being reported when they occur.

fields.name: precip_inches
fields.description: Precipitation in inches (min 0.0, max 1.06 across 50 distinct values), a measured quantity summed or compared across rows, never null.

fields.name: pressure_mb
fields.description: Barometric pressure in millibars (min 983.8, max 1038.4 across 430 distinct values), a measured quantity; nullable in 11.5% of rows (null_rate 0.114953).

fields.name: visibility_miles
fields.description: Visibility distance in miles (min 0.0, max 10.0, capped distinct_values list of 20 values shown), a measured quantity, never null.

fields.name: airport_name
fields.description: Full airport name (John F. Kennedy International Airport, LaGuardia Airport, Newark Liberty International Airport per distinct_values), never null.

fields.name: airport_municipality
fields.description: Municipality of the airport (New York or Newark per distinct_values), never null.

fields.name: airport_elevation_ft
fields.description: Airport elevation in feet, a fixed descriptive attribute per station (13, 18, or 21 per distinct_values) rather than a measured quantity, never null.

fields.name: airport_longest_runway_ft
fields.description: Longest runway length in feet, a fixed descriptive attribute per station (7002, 11000, or 14511 per distinct_values), never null.

fields.name: captured_at
fields.description: Capture timestamp recorded by the ingestion process (3 distinct values clustered within seconds on 2026-09-02), a lineage marker rather than the event time, never null.

category_description: One row represents a single hourly weather observation recorded at one of three NYC-area airports (EWR, JFK, LGA per airport_code distinct_values), capturing temperature, dewpoint, humidity, wind, precipitation, visibility, and pressure conditions along with static station attributes for that airport at that hour.
purpose: This mapping declares how the silver_airport_weather table (row_count 13014) enters the gold unified event star as the airport_weather_observations fact category, assigning the time column, hour grain, transaction identity, and field roles that the deterministic modeling engine consumes to generate gold models; it is read by the modeling engine, never executed itself.
usage: The proposal is rendered into an ODCS mapping contract draft, validated against the frozen mapping-contract schema, linted, and reviewed by a human before approval; once approved, consumers query the resulting gold fact by airport_code and observed_hour_utc alongside the mapped weather measures and station dimensions.
limitations: The mapping does not filter, impute, or otherwise transform the nulls present in wind_gust_mph (null_rate 0.745505), pressure_mb (null_rate 0.114953), or wind_dir_degrees (null_rate 0.016828); handling of missing readings is left to downstream consumers, and the contract does not reconcile the small gap between row_count (13014) and the airport_code times observed_hour_utc distinct-value product (13023) implied by the profile.
